text: That was when things begun to change in the forest. The animals stopped coming out to peek at the village. The birds stopped their cheerful songs. The bright clearing became dark and gloomy. From that day on, the forest was a dark and haunted place. Fewer and fewer aislings would venture in further than the eaves to collect firewood. Only the few folk who lived in the forest would brave the trails, and even then, never at night. The forest bore the taint of anger, of evil.
